items.title: Actions are by intentions
items.arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
items.translation: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get only what they intended.

items.title: The five pillars of Islam
items.translation: Islam is built upon five: testimony of faith, establishing prayer, paying zakat, fasting Ramadan, and performing Hajj for whoever is able.

items.title: Halal and haram are clear
items.arabic: إِنَّ الْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ وَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ
items.translation: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are doubtful matters. Whoever avoids doubtful matters clears himself regarding his religion and honor.

items.title: Leave what doubts you
items.arabic: دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
items.translation: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.

items.title: Faith has seventy-odd branches
items.translation: Faith has seventy-odd branches. The highest is saying 'La ilaha illallah' and the lowest is removing harm from the road. Modesty is a branch of faith.

items.title: The rights of a Muslim over another
items.translation: A Muslim has five rights over another Muslim: return the greeting, visit the sick, follow the funeral, accept an invitation, and say 'Yarhamuk Allah' when he sneezes.

items.title: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day
items.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
items.translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

items.title: Do not envy one another
items.arabic: لَا تَحَاسَدُوا وَلَا تَنَاجَشُوا وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا
items.translation: Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices against one another, do not hate one another, and do not turn away from one another. Be servants of Allah as brothers.

items.title: The best of people
items.translation: The best of people are those most beneficial to people.

items.title: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty
items.translation: Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty.

items.title: Make things easy, not difficult
items.translation: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not repel people.

items.title: The strong is not the one who overcomes
items.translation: The strong person is not the one who overcomes others in wrestling; the strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.

items.title: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother
items.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
items.translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

items.title: The world is a prison for the believer
items.translation: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

items.title: Be in this world as a stranger
items.arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
items.translation: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.

items.title: Brotherhood in faith
items.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
items.translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

items.title: Kind speech is charity
items.translation: A good word is charity.

items.title: Smiling is charity
items.arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
items.translation: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.

items.title: Whoever relieves a believer
items.translation: Whoever relieves a believer of distress in this world, Allah will relieve him of distress on the Day of Resurrection.

items.title: Cleanliness is half of faith
items.translation: Cleanliness is half of faith.

items.title: Seeking knowledge is obligatory
items.arabic: طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ
items.translation: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.

items.title: The best charity
items.arabic: أَفْضَلُ الصَّدَقَةِ أَنْ تَصَدَّقَ وَأَنْتَ صَحِيحٌ شَحِيحٌ
items.translation: The best charity is that which you give while you are healthy and eager for wealth, fearing poverty and hoping to become rich.

items.title: Allah does not look at your bodies
items.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ
items.translation: Allah does not look at your bodies or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

items.title: The believer to the believer
items.translation: The believers in their mutual kindness, compassion, and sympathy are like one body—when one limb suffers, the whole body responds with sleeplessness and fever.

items.title: Whoever removes a worldly hardship
items.translation: Whoever eases hardship for someone in this world, Allah will ease hardship for him on the Day of Resurrection.

items.title: The five daily prayers
items.arabic: مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَيْهِنَّ كَانَ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَهْدٌ
items.translation: Whoever performs ablution well and prays the five daily prayers, Allah has a covenant with him to enter Paradise.

items.title: The best of you are best to their families
items.translation: The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.

items.title: Modesty brings nothing but good
items.translation: Modesty brings nothing but good.

items.title: Allah is kind and loves kindness
items.translation: Allah is Kind and loves kindness in all matters.

items.title: Paradise lies at the feet of mothers
items.translation: Paradise lies at the feet of mothers.

items.title: Allah is kind and loves kindness
items.translation: Allah is Kind and loves kindness in all matters.

items.title: Gentleness beautifies
items.arabic: إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لَا يَكُونُ فِي شَيْءٍ إِلَّا زَانَهُ
items.translation: Gentleness is not in anything except that it beautifies it.

items.title: The strong believer
items.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ
items.translation: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is good in both.

items.title: Do not get angry
items.translation: Do not get angry.

items.title: The most beloved deeds to Allah
items.arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
items.translation: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are small.

items.title: Whoever does not show mercy
items.translation: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.

items.title: The best of you in character
items.translation: The best among you are those who have the best character.

items.title: Exchange gifts and you will love one another
items.translation: Exchange gifts and you will love one another.

items.title: The tongue can lead to Hellfire
items.arabic: أَكْثَرُ مَا يُدْخِلُ النَّاسَ الْجَنَّةَ تَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَحُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ
items.translation: The things that most lead people to Paradise are consciousness of Allah and good character.

items.title: Visit the sick
items.translation: No Muslim visits a sick Muslim in the morning except that seventy thousand angels send blessings upon him until evening.

items.title: The rights of neighbors
items.translation: Jibril kept advising me about the neighbor until I thought he would make him an heir.

items.title: Backbiting is worse than adultery
items.translation: Do you know what backbiting is? It is mentioning your brother in a manner that he dislikes.

items.title: Actions are by intentions
items.translation: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.

items.title: The five pillars
items.translation: Islam is built upon five: testimony of faith, prayer, zakat, fasting Ramadan, and Hajj.

items.title: The pillars of faith
items.translation: Faith is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine decree—its good and its bad.

items.title: Creation in the womb
items.translation: Each of you is gathered in the womb for forty days as a drop, then a clot, then a lump of flesh. Then an angel breathes the soul and writes four matters.

items.title: Rejecting evil
items.translation: Whoever sees an evil, let him change it with his hand. If he cannot, then with his tongue. If he cannot, then with his heart—and that is the weakest of faith.

items.title: Halal, haram, and doubtful matters
items.translation: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear. Between them are doubtful matters that many people do not know.

items.title: Religion is sincere advice
items.translation: Religion is sincere advice. We said: To whom? He said: To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims, and their common people.

items.title: Forbidden blood, wealth, and honor
items.translation: Allah has forbidden you blood, unlawful wealth, and acting dishonorably toward your mothers.

items.title: Avoid what you are ordered to avoid
items.translation: What I have forbidden for you, avoid. What I have ordered you to do, do as much of it as you can.

items.title: Allah is pure and accepts only what is pure
items.translation: Allah is Pure and accepts only what is pure. He has commanded the believers what He commanded the messengers.

items.title: Leave what does not concern you
items.translation: Part of a person's excellence in Islam is leaving what does not concern him.

items.title: The excellence of gathering for Quran and dhikr
items.translation: No people gather in one of the houses of Allah reciting the Book of Allah and studying it together except that tranquility descends upon them.

items.title: Love for your brother what you love for yourself
items.translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

items.title: The sanctity of a Muslim
items.translation: Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.

items.title: Speak good or remain silent
items.translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

items.title: Do not become angry
items.translation: A man asked the Prophet for advice and he said: Do not become angry. The man repeated his request several times and he replied: Do not become angry.

items.title: Allah has prescribed excellence in everything
items.translation: Allah has prescribed excellence (ihsan) in all things. So when you kill, kill well; and when you slaughter, slaughter well.

items.title: Fear Allah wherever you are
items.translation: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with good character.
items.narrator: Abu Dharr and Muadh ibn Jabal (RA)

items.title: Hold fast to the Sunnah
items.translation: I urge you to adhere to my Sunnah and the way of the rightly guided caliphs. Beware of newly invented matters, for every innovation is misguidance.

items.title: Every person's joints owe charity each day
items.translation: Every joint of a person must perform charity each day: justice between two people is charity; helping a person with his animal is charity.

items.title: Ask Allah for forgiveness and well-being
items.translation: Ask Allah for forgiveness and well-being, for no one is given anything after certainty better than well-being.

items.title: The signs of a hypocrite
items.translation: The signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is entrusted he betrays.

items.title: The pure heart
items.translation: There is a piece of flesh in the body—if it is sound, the whole body is sound; if it is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt. It is the heart.

items.title: Rights of Allah and rights of people
items.translation: The right of Allah over His servants is that they worship Him and associate nothing with Him. The right of servants over Allah is that He not punish those who do not associate partners with Him.

items.title: The lawful and the unlawful are clear
items.translation: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear. Between them are doubtful matters that many do not know.

items.title: The virtue of good character
items.translation: The most beloved of you to me and the nearest to me on the Day of Resurrection are those with the best character.

items.title: Allah's right over His servants
items.translation: O My servants, I have forbidden injustice for Myself and made it forbidden among you, so do not wrong one another.

items.title: The world is the prison of the believer
items.translation: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

items.title: Allah's shade on the Day of Judgment
items.translation: Seven will be shaded by Allah on the Day when there is no shade but His: a just ruler, a youth who grew up worshipping Allah, and others.

items.title: The condition of the heart
items.translation: If the heart is sound, the whole body is sound; if the heart is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt.

items.title: Avoid doubtful matters
items.translation: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.

items.title: No harm and no reciprocating harm
items.translation: There should be neither harm nor reciprocating harm.

items.title: The world is cursed except dhikr and knowledge
items.translation: The world is cursed and what is in it is cursed, except the remembrance of Allah, what helps it, the scholar, and the student.

items.title: Allah is good and accepts only good
items.translation: Allah is Good and accepts only what is good.

items.title: Allah loves those who repent
items.translation: Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.

items.title: Be in the world as a stranger
items.translation: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.

items.title: The rights of Allah upon His servants
items.translation: Allah's right upon His servants is that they worship Him alone and associate nothing with Him.

items.title: Call upon Allah with certainty
items.translation: Call upon Allah while being certain of the response, and know that Allah does not answer a supplication from a heedless, distracted heart.

items.title: Allah has pardoned my ummah for mistakes
items.translation: Allah has pardoned my ummah for their mistakes, forgetfulness, and what they are forced to do.

items.title: Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you
items.translation: Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him before you.

items.title: Before sleeping
items.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

items.title: Upon waking
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.

items.title: Entering the home
items.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.

items.title: Leaving the home
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah.

items.title: Before eating
items.translation: In the name of Allah.

items.title: After eating
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.

items.title: Entering the masjid
items.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

items.title: Leaving the masjid
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

items.title: When distressed
items.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ
items.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the magnificent Throne.

items.title: For forgiveness
items.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, for You are the Ever-Relenting, the Most Merciful.

items.title: When it rains
items.translation: O Allah, let it be a beneficial downpour.

items.title: When hearing thunder
items.translation: Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of fear of Him.
